○ stepdown-00h · UX: Fix command has no --dry-run mode   [● P3 · OPEN]
Owner: pendragon.josh@gmail.com · Type: feature
Created: 2026-03-03 · Updated: 2026-07-27

Human `fix` subcommand writes immediately with no preview. Add `--dry-run` that prints diffs without writing. Note: `agents fix` / pipeline already support dry-run.

Acceptance Criteria:
## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `stepdown-rule fix --dry-run <glob>` exits 0 and prints proposed diffs
- [ ] No files on disk are modified when `--dry-run` is set
- [ ] Without `--dry-run`, fix behavior unchanged
- [ ] Help text documents `--dry-run`

Notes:
2026-07-26: still valid in code (not landed). Prior erroneous deferral reversed — age alone is not grounds to park.
No dependencies for stepdown-00h
